# ShellX Motion platform verification

Run the platform ladder separately on every operating system and architecture that will be claimed for a release. A source build or a result from another host is not substitute evidence. The runner records the host identity, command plan, outcomes, and artifact paths in one receipt.

## Required commands

These commands form the core host ladder.

<!-- platform-verify:required-commands generated by scripts/platform-verification-doc-gate.mjs -->

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run debug:coverage
pnpm run agent:smoke
pnpm run agent-unavailable:smoke
pnpm run debug-server:smoke
pnpm run debug-server-prompt:smoke
pnpm run validate:fixtures
pnpm run package-archive:smoke
pnpm run canvas-package-preview:smoke
pnpm run evidence-surfaces:smoke
pnpm run sandbox:probe
pnpm run tracking:smoke
pnpm run render:smoke
pnpm run render-mp4:smoke
pnpm run ffmpeg-acceleration:smoke
pnpm run render-webm:smoke
pnpm run render-hevc:smoke
pnpm run render-av1:smoke
pnpm run render-audio:smoke
pnpm run render-caption:smoke
pnpm run render-alpha:smoke
pnpm run render-gif:smoke
pnpm run render-jpeg:smoke
pnpm run browser:capture-smoke
pnpm run workbench:ui-smoke
pnpm run source-storyboard:smoke
pnpm run render-job-lifecycle:smoke
pnpm run render-batch:smoke
pnpm run connector:smoke
pnpm run connector:canvas-mp4-smoke
pnpm run connector:script-cut-smoke
pnpm run connector:template-cut-smoke
pnpm run connector:template-cut-render-smoke
```

<!-- /platform-verify:required-commands -->

`debug-server:smoke` verifies the loopback MCP surface over HTTP and authenticated WebSocket JSON-RPC, including discovery, dispatch, `tools/list`, and `tools/call`. A passing process check without those protocol exercises is not equivalent coverage.

## Extended commands

Use the extended tier for a release candidate so optional codec and integration surfaces are exercised where the host supports them.

<!-- platform-verify:extended-commands generated by scripts/platform-verification-doc-gate.mjs -->

```bash
pnpm run template-pack:proof
# ...or through the runner, so the host receipt records them alongside the core tier:
pnpm run platform:verify -- --run --include-extended --host-id <id>
```

<!-- /platform-verify:extended-commands -->

## Optional integrations

Optional commands run only when their required checkout or host configuration is present. An unavailable optional integration must be recorded as unavailable; it must not be reported as passed.

<!-- platform-verify:optional-commands generated by scripts/platform-verification-doc-gate.mjs -->

- `connector:canvas-bridge-smoke` requires `SHELLX_CANVAS_ROOT`.
- `connector:canvas-bridge-mp4-smoke` requires `SHELLX_CANVAS_ROOT`.
- `connector:canvas-cut-smoke` requires `SHELLX_CANVAS_ROOT`.

<!-- /platform-verify:optional-commands -->

## Run and preserve the receipt

For release verification, prefer one complete run that continues after failures and includes the extended tier:

```bash
pnpm run platform:verify -- --run --collect-all --include-extended --require-modern-codecs --host-id <host-id> --out <receipt.json>
```

Keep the receipt with the candidate's release evidence outside the public source distribution. Confirm that it identifies the exact candidate, contains no unexpected skips, and points to the artifacts inspected on that same host.

## Runner options

<!-- platform-verify:options generated by scripts/platform-verification-doc-gate.mjs -->

```text
  --dry-run              Print the planned host verification receipt (default)
  --run                  Execute the verification commands sequentially
  --json                 Print machine-readable JSON
  --out <path>           Write the receipt JSON to a file
  --host-id <id>         Override host id (default: SHELLX_MOTION_HOST_ID or hostname)
  --required-hosts <ids> Required host ids for matrix evidence (default: linux,windows,macos; use "none" to omit)
  --verify-receipts <paths...> Verify collected platform receipts for all required hosts
  --require-host-connectors Promote env-gated Cut/Design Studio connector checks to required commands
  --phase2-connectors      Alias for --require-host-connectors
  --require-exact-toolchain Require hashed Node/pnpm/FFmpeg/FFprobe and required encoder evidence
  --require-bundled-codecs Require exact toolchain plus configured ShellX-bundled FFmpeg/FFprobe
  --require-modern-codecs  Fail (instead of skip) when the host FFmpeg does not advertise hevc/av1
  --include-extended       Include extended-tier commands (template-pack:proof, ~5 minutes)
  --collect-all            Run every command even after a failure and report the complete result set
  --no-fail-fast           Alias for --collect-all
  --only <id,id>         Run or plan only selected command ids
  --command-timeout-ms <n> Per-command timeout in milliseconds (default: 1800000)
  --help                 Show this help
```

<!-- /platform-verify:options -->

## Interpreting results

- A passing command proves only the behavior that command exercises on the recorded host.
- A skipped optional command is not a pass. Record why it was unavailable.
- Inspect generated video, image, and audio artifacts rather than relying only on process exit codes.
- Keep credentials, host routing, local checkout paths, signing details, and release-operation history out of public documentation and public receipts.
